title: Get the format reference
description: Returns the product's `FormatReference` from `formatReference(repoRoot)`: the meta-model with the product's extensions merged, and Lathe's checks with the product's own.

title: Get a record's history
description: `GET /api/history?id=<record ID>` (and `&skip=<n>` for older commits) answers with the commits that touched the record's spec file; `&commit=<hash>` answers with that commit's diff of the file, and `&commit=working` with the changes not committed yet. `lathe serve`, the app's Vite plugin and the desktop app (through `serve()`) all serve it.

title: Get the whole workspace
description: Returns the `Workspace` JSON from `loadWorkspace(repoRoot)`. One call returns everything; the client does all navigation. When the fixture is served, the response carries `x-lathe-source: fixture`.
